claims.text: For Business Single and Group Stage III, Table 3 lists a basic fee of KES 1,200 per candidate and a paper fee of KES 650. These components are not a complete individual invoice; confirm papers and any applicable additional charges.
Principals generate an examination-fee invoice and follow the registration-platform link for payment through eCitizen.
